'''Pogu''' was a [[Evocii]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] warrior during the [[Galactic War]], when he could be found on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Ziost Shadow]]''.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Evocii Avenger Pogu was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.2, as a Nightmare Force Vendor for Operation: Scum and Villainy,<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/2.2/operation-nightmare|text=Game Update 2.2: Operation Nightmare Patch Notes}}</ref> though he was later removed in a reorganizing of endgame gear.<ref name="TOR" />
